value.rationale: An exact spatial return-time law of the natural positive-density set of Stern indices divisible by three is not furnished by its known one-point density or individual residue formulas. The theorem resolves all gap lengths and frequencies, the sharp maximum, forbidden gap values and variance with exact rational certificates, and the answer is structurally motivated rather than an arbitrary enumeration.
